text:
Kim (sales): Calyx HealthTech asked if we can run a 2-week POC for their "calyx-30b-ftx" variant and add it to our catalog. They need a presales checklist: tokenizer compatibility, perf numbers, and enterprise security (BYOK + PHI). Can we triage?
Rafael (SE): quick clarifiers: is this a full model or adapters on top? tokenization changes? expected max seq lengths?
Dr. Priet (Calyx HealthTech): full 30B checkpoint (sharded), plus two domain adapters. Tokenizer = sentencepiece with 4 extra tokens for device codes. Typical requests 256-3k, occasional huge reports ~15k. We want VPC + BYOK and strict log redaction.
Zoe (solutions): proposed steps: 1) artifact upload -> run tokenizer parity test 2) fusion test for adapters -> ensure no token offset shifts 3) run 3k and 15k generate profiles to measure KV growth and memory 4) staging perf run for p95 token latency at steady 80 rps / burst 300 rps 5) commercial: estimate Dedicated vs Hosted + commit options.
Rafael (SE): short compat bash for staging upload:
```
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/models/compat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST" \
  -F "artifact=@calyx_30b_sharded.tar.gz" \
  -F "meta=@meta.json" \
  -F "samples=@calyx_samples.zip"
```
Dr. Priet (Calyx HealthTech): will upload artifacts + 10 samples (including tokenized examples and PHI-marked docs) by EOD. Also need a rough SLA: they asked for 95p token latency ~70ms.
Rafael (SE): 70ms p95 per token on 30B int8 is tight. On Dedicated A100 pool with batching we might approach ~80-120ms for <=512 tokens; 3k and 15k contexts will be higher due to KV and memory. We'll run staging to get measured numbers.
Zoe (solutions): fallback proposal: route non-sensitive traffic to a 13B distilled variant when Dedicated pressure spikes. PHI-tagged requests -> enforce private-only routing to BYOK nodes. Calyx okay with that?
Dr. Priet (Calyx HealthTech): fallback fine for non-PHI. PHI requests must never leave VPC.
Amit (security): intake checklist: completed vendor questionnaire (link below), KMS ARN for BYOK, data flow diagram, SOC2/ISO copies if available, retention and access policy. Also: confirm that analytics will be disabled for PHI-tagged requests.
Amit (security): security form: https://redwood.internal/sec-forms/calyx-poc (fill sections 1-4). We'll draft a PHI addendum for legal.
UploadBot: scheduled compat-run job #job-9453 for 2025-06-09T02:30:00Z (staging). Est runtime ~50m.
Rafael (SE): owners: artifact + samples (Calyx), compat tests & perf (Rafael), pricing + commit options (Zoe), security intake (Amit), sales deck update (Kim). ETA: samples today -> tests tomorrow -> initial perf + pricing by EoW.
Zoe (solutions): rough pricing note: if most calls are under 512 tokens hosted is likely cheaper; lots of 15k calls push toward Dedicated/Private with larger memory nodes. I'll run the estimator after we see sequence distribution.
Kim (sales): I'll update the deal doc and include risk notes: custom tokens, BYOK, and PHI routing. Thanks team.
Dr. Priet (Calyx HealthTech): uploading now. please call out if tokenization examples reveal any surprises. Appreciate quick turnaround. :rocket:
